excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: I’m afraid that expiring transactions are not a high priority for core devs. They have some use cases, yes, but there are many other desired features (for accounts and otherwise) that have priority right now. I think the most helpful thing to try and persuade people that expiring transactions should be done is to prove that either i) it’s simple to implement and safe or ii) provides a very important functionality. Both would be ideal
